notes.title: 0.5.2 Update
notes.notes:
In this update we added brand new weapon - EMP, launching a torpedo which explodes near an enemy ship and limits it's all capabilities. Also while zooming using railguns, all shooting points moving to the sight's center as a single crosshair.

New knocking out system. From now on every ship after deal a lethal damage doesn't become destroyed but knocking out. Teammate have 1 minute to stabilize player's ship. Until that moment player won’t be able to manipulate his ship in any way. Important: If you playing alone (solo) - ship will be destroyed as usual.
Tankers are now able to attack player's ship on approaching

[b]Changelist:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b][Change][/b] All installed railguns selected by the same group are now shooting at the sight's center as a single crosshair
[*] [b][Add][/b] New ship knoking out system:
[list]
[*] Ship will be knocked out after getting critical damage in terms if there will be more than 1 player in the same party, otherwise ship will be destroyed
[*] Teammates have 1 minute to recover player's ship after him being knocked out
[*] Recovering process can be started by sending a drone directly at teammate's ship. After 15 seconds passed - knocked out teammate will be able to fly and fight again.
[*] After recovering process has been finished, player's ship is gains 20% from ship's hull health
[*] If all your teammates took a lethal damage in battle while player's ship was still knocked out at the same moment - all ships in that party will be destroyed at once
[/list]
[*] [b][Add][/b] New type of weapon - EMP torpedo launcher. Torpedo explosion creates EMP field giving next effects to player's ship if it is in range:
[list]
[*] Generator starting to work on one third of it's full power
[*] Shileds are become depleted fully and doesn't recover
[*] Max and cruise speed are reducing
[/list]
[*] [b][Change][/b] Tanker from now using it's own weaponry on board. It can be destroyed by shooting their location spot 
[*] [b][Change][/b] All weapons been given the new titles
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.1 - Energy distribution
notes.notes:
In this update, we've added a ship power distributor that allows you to give power priority to a certain group of systems. For example, if you need to catch up with the enemy or quickly escape from the battlefield to recover, it is possible to give priority to thrusters and main engines, or if more firepower is needed, give priority to gun systems.
We also reworked the balance of the requirements of gun systems to the ship's power

List of changes:

[list]
[*] [b][change][/b] Added power distribution system for ships
[*] [b][change][/b] The ship's energy shield restore system has been changed. Shield restoration now consumes the appropriate portion of the Power Distributor. If the distributor runs out of energy to replenish the shields, charging stops until the energy distributor has accumulated the minimum amount of energy to restore the protection systems
[*] [b][change][/b] The system of energy consumption and reservation of weapon systems has been changed. Now, when installing weapon systems, the initial reservation of energy in the distributor for the entire fireteam takes place. If some weapon did not have enough energy for the reservation, it will not be able to be activated. Also, when fired, each weapon consumes the corresponding section of energy in the distributor.
[*] [b][change][/b] The system for improving thrusters and main engines has been changed. The power output of the thrusters and main engines as well as the maximum speed of the ship now depends on the level of the engines, the energy generator level and the priority in the power distributor
[*] [b][change][/b] Chaffs decoys now have a limited number of charges
[*] [b][Change][/b] Ship armor now has a separate health bar that depends on the armor level.
[*] [b][Change][/b] Changed the player's HUD to display the necessary information on the distribution of the ship's energy and the status of the ship's armor
[*] [b][change][/b] Added power distribution setting keys in the control settings menu
[/list]

notes.title: Development news
notes.notes:
There hasn't been any news or updates from our team lately, we're here to fix that.

At the moment, our team is working on stabilizing the entire gameplay, as well as quality of life changings that makes it easier to navigate in the game world.

We are working on improving the server side of our game for a better gaming experience and improved synchronization between players.

We are also working on an in-game map, so that players can better navigate the battlefield and build a combat strategy.

Our team is also working on the implementation of an anti-cheat system, so that players feel more protected from intruders who disrupt the gameplay.

Stay with us, we will keep you informed of all project changes

notes.title: Fixing Tutorial mode
notes.notes: We have corrected the descriptions in the tutorial mode, so now you can better and faster adapt to the rapidly changing conditions on the battlefield

notes.title: Patch 0.2.55
notes.notes:
In this update, all the ships provided by our engineers became truly unique, because they received additional special abilities. Each of the abilities reflects the character of the ship, and allows you to expand the variability of scenarios and strategies on the battlefield. 

To activate any ship's special ability for 5 seconds - press the corresponding activation key. Re-activation will require 10 seconds to cooldown

With Eagle's "Stealth" special ability you can vanish from every single radar and HUD for 5 seconds

Due to the special ability "Fury", the Blade is able to fire without losing energy resources for 5 seconds

Hawk's special ability "Boost" increases the maximum speed within 5 seconds

Activating the special ability "Gain", the Assassin absorbs any damage for 5 seconds

notes.title: New map "Asteroid rings" and new 0.2.42 update
notes.notes:
We are happy to present you a new map for exploration and battle - asteroid rings near the largest gas giant in the solar system - Jupiter.

On this map, you have to choose between open spaces around the ring, or a dense cluster of asteroids inside.
The new map boasts memorable places such as the logistics center of the region around Jupiter - a small sorting station, as well as ships of the Martian fleet patrol.

This update may offer you improved AI behavior in combat, as well as new features, such as an improved onboard ship function - flight assistant.

[list]
[*][b][addition][/b] Adding a new map "Rings of Jupiter"
[*][b][new functionality][/b] A new functionality has appeared in the work of the on-board computer - a switchable in-flight assistance option (do not forget to look at the keyboard settings menu to see how this function is enabled, we also added a different option for shutdowns - either temporary shutdown on hold, or switching modes)
[*][b][change][/b] We talked to our pilots and asked them to play with our guests more often so that they would not be bored in flight
[*][b][change][/b] We also asked our pilots to fly to our guests faster if they were too far from them, and only in the vicinity to show all their skills
[*][b][fix][/b] We also asked our pilots not to ram our guests anymore, because it's not sports
[*][b][change][/b] We explained to our pilots what the meaning of the game is, now they return to the combat zone if for some reason they find themselves outside of it
[*][b][fix][/b] From that moment on, AI ships stopped using multiple launch rocket systems, before the battle they are given standard homing missile launchers
[*][b][change][/b] We have worked with cargo ship markings on the radar and HUD. Now it will be easier for you to distinguish the tanker from other enemy targets
[*][b][change][/b] We also visited the AI ​​ship assembly line, and allowed workers to paint ships in other colors, and even use skins
[*][b][fix][/b] We have worked on the firmware of the loot drone, and fixed bugs that sometimes allowed the drone forgot some necessary items in containers
[/list]
